integrity: A standalone exact spectral-projector computation supports the analytic proof; finite sample numerical witnesses are approximate and are not claimed to certify exact times.
scientific_limitations: Exact physical observation times and probabilities are guaranteed to exist but not given in closed form; no smallest-support or time-horizon bound, instantaneous uniform mixing, or general graph-product classification. No independent external validation is claimed.
title: Exact shared-clock randomized uniform quantum mixing on the \(3\times4\) path grid
